items.source: Delegates to the given PersistenceExceptionTranslator to translate a RuntimeException thrown into Spring's DataAccessException hierarchy (if appropriate). If the RuntimeException in question is declared on the target method, it is always propagated as-is (with no translation applied).
items.translation: 委托给指定的 PersistenceExceptionTranslator 以将抛出的 RuntimeException 转换为 Spring 的 DataAccessException 层次结构（如果适用）。如果该 RuntimeException 在目标方法上已声明，则始终按原样传播（不应用任何转换）。

items.source: Note that the originating method does not have to declare the specific exception. Any base class will do as well, even throws Exception: As long as the originating method does explicitly declare compatible exceptions, the raw exception will be rethrown. If you would like to avoid throwing raw exceptions in any case, switch this flag to "true".
items.translation: 请注意，原始方法不必声明特定的异常。任何基类都可以，即使是 `throws Exception`：只要原始方法明确声明了兼容的异常，原始异常就会被重新抛出。如果您希望无论如何都避免抛出原始异常，请将此标志切换为 "true"。

items.translation: 默认情况下，会在包含的 BeanFactory 中自动检测所有的 PersistenceExceptionTranslators，并将它们以链式方式使用。

items.source:
Default is "false". Switch this flag to "true" in order to always translate
applicable exceptions, independent of the originating method signature.
items.translation: 默认值为 "false"。将此标志切换为 "true"，以便始终翻译适用的异常，而不管其源自的方法签名如何。
